why: The benchmark asked whether a consumer can build Accordee-grade screens with basalt. After the earlier rows the answer has to be shown, through the app profile and its lint at error, the way STOCKTAKE section 3 demands. These pages also become the exemplars an agent copies ("a list page copies this one") and replace the Accordee screenshots as the reference.
what: Pages in apps/playground on one fixture domain, their shots, and a findings list.
owns: apps/playground/src/** for the new pages and fixtures
packages/basalt-ui/agent/** exemplar pointers through its generator
must_not_touch: packages/basalt-ui/src/** (a gap found here is filed, not patched in this row)
change: Read first: docs/v3/issues/bench/README.md (owner direction, decisions, how to use the reference) and docs/v3/BENCHMARK-ACCORDEE-BLUEPRINT.md. On one invented domain that is not a CRM clone (pick one: a parts inventory with suppliers and purchase orders fits), with typed fixtures and a fixed "today": (1) a list page: view row with counted tabs and saved views, summary strip, a grid-look table with person, tags, status and countdown cells, sticky leading columns, group-by, footer aggregates, the manage-view panel, bulk bar, and the same set as board and gallery; (2) a second list in the Notes shape: title with a type icon, a quiet preview column, linked-record cells, no tick column; a row opens the record as peek, window or page with previous and next; (3) a record page: identity block with avatar and actions, a property list, tabs with counts, an activity list, related lists; (4) a settings page with sections of rows, choice cards, a matrix, a tag input, a danger row; (5) a create flow in the wizard dialog with a live preview. Every page compiles with zero basalt lint waivers and no `custom` column kind; where that is impossible, stop, write the gap down and file it with `factory issue new`, then continue with the rest. Run `basalt-ui shot` and the design reviewer on all of it. Then append a results section to the benchmark doc: per screen family of its section 2, built or not, and the gaps filed.
reference: The whole reference: ~/.local/state/basalt-accordee/reports/tables.md, records.md, settings.md. Look at tables/31-notes-rest.png, tables/38-invoices-rest.png, records/04-notes-record-as-drawer.png, records/12-customers-row-opened.png, settings/03-notifications-rest.png, records/38-contract-wizard-step-2.png for the level to reach, then judge by the rules in the README.
acceptance: The five pages render at 1800x1200 and 390x844 in light and dark and the design reviewer returns no P1
Zero basalt lint waivers and zero custom column kinds on these pages, or each exception names the Issue filed for it
The benchmark doc states per screen family whether it is now buildable
The skill names each page as the exemplar for its archetype
out_of_scope: Fixing package gaps in this row. Calendar, inbox, chat, workflow canvas pages (the next plan).
proof: The shot board of the five pages and the reviewer report, linked in the PR.
commits: Conventional, empty scope, packages/basalt-ui/** in its own commits. Never feat!: and no BREAKING CHANGE footer (docs/release.md). A changed or removed export updates migrations/areas and the generated docs in the same PR.
